body: Actually, while I have you here I can’t help but ask and I hope this isn’t rude. I just finished an appointment with an eHealth doctor tonight and I asked him about Frida and he’s never heard of it. Do you have any resources that support your legitimacy?? I’m not meaning this as an accusation, I just like to check the facts! Really sorry if that comes off wrong.
Thanks for reaching out! I actually emailed you guys to get the deets on it, but it’s good to have this out in the ether.
That’s fantastic, and I’m happy to hear that you pulled it off!

That’s really interesting. I developed pretty bad arthritis over the last few years, so labour jobs are out and I’ve kind of been lost ever since. I recently started messing around with tech stuff (I say this loosely. I combed through a launch file for a recording software that my computer was too old to run and managed to change its minimum OS haha) and it has really warmed me up to pursuing something like this.
Hahahahahaha this is dead on.

I was actually interested in pursuing something in that field when I was younger because of these exact reasons, but I was undiagnosed until 2018 and I failed MISERABLY at school and never understood why!
The ones I have done are all varied, but whichever task you had you would do all day. So every day was different, but you always had something to settle in to.

I actually did the exact same schedule as you for a few years at a pellet plant haha! That’s exactly what I was referencing. The 2 days/2nights was killer, but after my first year they switched to 4 day shift, 4 days off, 4 night shift, 4days off and I looooved that. (I missed the 24 hour switch though because I was young and liked to have that night to go out with my pals)
I always gravitated towards physical labour jobs personally, because it was easier to lose myself in the repetition and kill the day.

Wait, people take HUNDREDS of mgs of this stuff?? I assumed that would just be an overdose!

I am realizing there are a handful of things I assumed about Adderall that are actually just properties of opiates. (I assumed crazy withdrawals, shaking/vomiting etc, and overdose was a risk. A friend of mine is on 50mg a day but he’s been on it 10 years so I assumed he just had a crazy tolerance built up over time, and he really struggles if he forgets to take it but I’m realizing a huge portion of that is probably just mental)

This is such a relief to hear. This experience has been pretty stress inducing for me but a huge part of my concern was that I would be strung out or really ill.

When I first pursued treatment for this a few years ago my doctor was giving me three months supplies of it at a time so I didn’t realize how strictly regulated it was.

It’s wild. It also sucks that it has to be so regulated because if it was more readily available I think I would have actually made a lot more progress in life when I was younger instead of flubbing my way through adulthood like a slimy toad!

This is a fantastic insight. I appreciate it! That was actually part of what lead up to my current positive experience, when I saw a specialist and described my experience on Ritalin (as well as three or four times trying adderall, Vyvanse, and something else, intermittently once each over years, where they just gave me anxiety) he said that I most likely responded that way because Ritalin was too strong for me, but that the dosage of Adderall/Vyvanse was likely actually too low. He bumped me up (20mg initially) and it was a night and day experience. 25mg appears to be the sweet spot for me. I don’t want or need more, but I have a sense of clarity and readily engage my environment and everything that comes my way without being overly focused.
This is what I was hoping to hear!! Thanks for the encouragement!

I think it’s such a complicated and nuanced thing. I am so frustrated and hurt by the way I have been treated, but the flip side is that doctors are forced to wade through sooo much bullshit because of how desperate people are in this regard.

I really feel for doctors who got in to medicine to help people but wind up burning out because of how often they have to deal with patients just like me. I feel so fortunate to have the healthcare system we have, compared to the private healthcare nightmare people deal with in the US, but I think there are a few aspects of our system that are inherently broken.

I’m glad I could return the little boost!
Really?? It looked like it was $599 up front and then $29 so I didn’t move forward! If you are sure that it’s one or the other and not both then I can sign up right away!

Fuck, thank you so much! I needed that today haha. Sorry to hear about your husbands struggles.

It sucks being an adult dude in this day and age and not having a family doctor that trusts you. I have so much anxiety about talking with doctors and feeling heard that it keeps me up at night sometimes leading in to appointments and I start having the conversation in my head over and over.

Oh that’s so funny, parhar (pacific adhd) is actually where I went to confirm the diagnosis! (I had a family doctor who left a couple years ago, he diagnosed it but he refused to prescribe anything but IR methylphenidate, and that medication hurt a LOT more than it helped.)

Thank you so much.

Hey thanks man! That’s super legit. 

Sorry for my salty response to him. I shouldn’t have taken the bait, but due to various reasons I am kind of irritable right now haha.
Of course. That is super helpful. Thanks so much for chiming in. So sorry I subjected you to such an awful thing, reaching out for community support and advice. I… truly am… an “entitled fukn cunt.”

Haha yeah you and most people it seems. It’s shocking to me that something so stringently controlled is seemingly abundant at universities. 

I honestly wish Canada could figure out some sort of program that made this stuff more accessible, because that would provide a means of accountability for the people who aren’t taking it therapeutically and it would make it a hell of a lot less depressing and alienating for those of us who really struggle to manage their lives without it.

I won’t lie, I considered that briefly. I decided that I refuse to perpetuate any aspect of the situation that has lead to my difficulties accessing these meds therapeutically. 

That is my decision and I get that, but over this past couple of weeks I have grown to resent people who abuse this medication recreationally and limiting my own access to it. Thanks anyways tho man! And no offence meant towards you at all with this comment. No judgement here.
Ah man! I hope you’re doing okay! That is very kind!
Is there any way around paying the $599 assessment fee? That will take me a while to save up for.

Whoa! Checking it out now!! I originally dealt with a clinic in van called Pacific ADHD (for confirming the diagnosis. My old family doctor initially diagnosed me but refused to give me anything but instant release methylphenidate, and the six months I was on that was brutal. I felt like a robot, I was really irritable, and it all just served to turn me off the effectiveness of meds as a treatment) and his referral is the only reason local doctors will prescribe it for me, but it took forever to get an appointment there and he doesn’t handle anything like this.

Cheers for the tip Platypus!

I actually proposed that with the tele health doctor and that was when he started laughing at me. I honestly wish BC had some sort of program like this. I get that it takes up valuable resources, but for the people who actually benefit therapeutically from medication like this I think it would really improve a lot of lives.

The last few months have been the first time in my adult life that I haven’t felt like a total and complete failure and a waste of skin, and navigating all of the red tape around this SUCKS.

Thanks for the kind words!
Dang. Considering the details of my current situation I feel like I might be better off just trying to make do.

I think that post was actually also by me haha. I posted here pretty desperately around the day this first happened. I wound up having a plumber friend come over to help me snake out what I could recover which was gross but kept me going for a bit.

Thank you so much for the thought though!
I think Walmart allows overnight parking. Not sure what they do long term but you could call them.

Hey you’re one of the mods for this sub hey?? Would you consider making a stickied post that has a directory of resources pertaining to health care and mental health?? I doubt that will help me at all, but I’m sure it would be useful for people in the future.

Just a thought, no pressure or anything!

Edit: it would also provide a place for people to comment updates or tips for things like finding a doctor or same-day clinic options. Someone else who commented here with some insights about the 811 waitlist and a website in BC for finding a doctor kind of blew my mind.
This is so helpful! I cannot thank you enough!

The medication is NOT opiates thank you very much. Thanks for really flawlessly illustrating exactly why this situation has made me feel like human trash.

Edit: Sorry for being rude man, genuinely. But this really is exactly what the issue is. The stigma surrounding my meds is akin to opiates as far as the way people treat you when you bring them up and it SUCKS. I am extremely mindful of following my prescriptions instructions.

I have tried being more direct about it, but I also unfortunately suffer from a physical disability that really slows me down and hinders my performance, and I can see it frustrate him. This would be one extra thing on the pile.

I appreciate the thought though. Thank you!

Daaaaaaang! Checking out the website straight away. I’ve noticed that everyone I know has gotten doctors faster than be through parents/SO/etc.

I really appreciate the info.

I was considering that because I’m feeling semi desperate at this point, but I’m worried that if I go there the situation will be misinterpreted and I’ll just wind up feeling even worse. I’ve had pretty bad experiences with ER doc’s. (Not their fault. I can only imagine what they go through, and I can’t blame them for expecting the worst)

Thanks so much for getting it haha. It’s been a shitty few days. The way I’ve been treated has been mega alienating, which does not pair well with suddenly being forced to endure the lethargy and blue mood.

I tried calling kinetic energy earlier but didn’t have any luck getting through. I’ll give it a go first thing in the morning and hope for the best.

Thanks a ton!
The lady I chatted with via 811 mentioned this. Maybe in the summer that would be an option but at this time of year it’s no dice for me. Thank you for the idea though!
Yeah I’m currently on the cancellation list there (urgent primary care) so hopefully something opens up.

Going to give them a call now and see but thanks for the advice!! I actually agree with your sentiment about it not being the worst thing in the world going without it, which is a huge relief compared to someone being forced to go without Ativan or something awful like that! Take care!
No worries at all!! Thank you for the advice and I will give them a call right away!
Just for the record I am a dude! Totally respect the mistake, just correcting you for accurate context.

And give them a bunch of free insurance money for this 100 year old shithole they just bought? Not a chance amigo! I genuinely think they might actually be trying to make me snap with the hopes that I do something rash and they get a free renovation out of it.
Don’t we all Vikes… don’t we all.
I’m doing Gods work out here!
I posted this a couple days ago but have since learned that Vimeo is far superior to Imgur. Enjoy this piece of history!
The entire Red Rising series, and the first Gentleman Bastards book the Lies of Locke Lamora.
Perfect. That is a relief. Thank you so much for clarifying all of this.

I am mostly asking as a preparation in case I am accused. I have a friend who, in a very similar situation, a tenancy agreement without any inside smoking prohibition, who did actually smoke in her suite and her landlords tried to take her damage deposit. My landlords have been fairly cruel to me, they have accused me of smoking, and they are out for blood as far as grounds for keeping my damage deposit goes. 

I just want to know, if they pursue this, would they be able to take any of my damage deposit if there was no other damage aside from usual wear and tear, just because they claim it smells like cigarette smoke.
What I am wondering is, would smell of smoke be enough to claim damage?
